# netbox_circuit (Data Source)

A circuit leased from a provider (circuits.circuit).

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/features/circuits/#circuits_1):

> A communications circuit represents a single physical link connecting exactly two endpoints, commonly referred to as its A and Z terminations. A circuit in NetBox may have zero, one, or two terminations defined. It is common to have only one termination defined when you don't necessarily care about the details of the provider side of the circuit, e.g. for Internet access circuits. Both terminations would likely be modeled for circuits which connect one customer site to another.
>
> Each circuit is associated with a provider and a user-defined type. For example, you might have Internet access circuits delivered to each site by one provider, and private MPLS circuits delivered by another. Each circuit must be assigned a circuit ID, each of which must be unique per provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_circuit" "test" {
  id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cid` (String) Circuit id assigned by the provider; unique per provider.
- `cid_contains` (String) Case-insensitive substring of the circuit id.
- `circuit_provider_id` (Number) Id of the provider the circuit is leased from.
- `circuit_type_id` (Number) Id of the circuit type.
- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `status` (String) Operational status. One of: planned, provisioning, active, offline, deprovisioning, decommissioned.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.

### Read-Only

- `comments` (String)
- `commit_rate_kbps` (Number) Committed rate in kbps.
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `install_date` (String) Installation date as YYYY-MM-DD.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `tenant_id` (Number) Id of the tenant.
- `termination_date` (String) Termination date as YYYY-MM-DD.
- `url` (String)
